svg.title: Expected trace waterfall
svg.desc: POST /run contains diagnose_workload. The workflow makes two model calls and invokes two tools. The diagnostic agent runs locally. The runbook tool makes an HTTP client call to a separate service, whose HTTP server span contains the runbook agent and its model call. Names and nesting are conceptual. Bar positions follow the visible extents of the corresponding spans in the saved Aspire capture on the same 0 to 0.7 second axis. Timing is approximate screenshot geometry, not recovered OTLP timestamps. Teal identifies diagnostic-agent spans; gold identifies runbook spans.
